entry.title: New: dsh-mcp-skill-panel
entry.summary: MCP & Skill manager: enable/disable MCP servers and skills from a Settings panel to free context in real time; optional AI middle layer (mcp_search/mcp_call) calls disabled servers on demand, with state-based visibility filtering that keeps user-enabled servers visible. Exact install spec: github:lilyblessing/dsh-mcp-skill-panel. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
